findings.problem: Three proofs in this file repeat the same slot-level argument. Take a burned boundary witness k from exists_chip_up or exists_chip_down, or its chip-free contrapositive. Split on whether k is the far endpoint. If it is, rewrite with slotVertex_length or slotVertex_zero plus a transitionSlot_head/tail fact to get a chip on the core vertex. If it is not, apply apply_slotVertex_le_slotInteriorChips to get a chip in the slot interior. one_le_transitionPath_up (lines 142-146) and one_le_transitionPath_down (lines 166-170) are mirror images of each other. burned_vMinus_of_chipFree (lines 192-196) redoes the same split for the contrapositive. The argument holds for an arbitrary slot and uses nothing about the tricycle. It is only specialised by the three-line hcore rewrites. The same split occurs again, in the hc1/hc2 blocks, in the two cycle-blocking lemmas of SpecBurning.lean.
findings.proposed_change:
Add two general lemmas, next to apply_slotVertex_le_slotInteriorChips in SpecBurning.lean or at the top of this file, for any `edge : Fin p`.

1. `one_le_slotInteriorChips_add_head (hEff : effective D) {edge} (ha : spec.slotVertex edge 0 ∈ burned spec.graph D w) (hb : spec.slotVertex edge (spec.length edge) ∉ burned spec.graph D w) : 1 ≤ spec.slotInteriorChips D edge + D (spec.coreVertex (spec.core.head edge))`.
2. `one_le_slotInteriorChips_add_tail`, the mirror, with the length vertex burned and vertex 0 unburned. It concludes `1 ≤ spec.slotInteriorChips D edge + D (spec.coreVertex (spec.core.tail edge))`.

Proof sketch for lemma 1: take `⟨k, hk0, hkle, hkchip, -, -⟩ := exists_chip_up ha hb (Nat.zero_le _) (le_refl _)`. Do `rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hkle`. In the equal case, `rw [heq, slotVertex_length] at hkchip`, then use `slotInteriorChips_nonneg hEff edge` and omega. In the strict case, use apply_slotVertex_le_slotInteriorChips and `hEff` on the head, then omega. Lemma 2 is the same with exists_chip_down and Nat.eq_zero_or_pos.

The rewritten uses are as follows.
- `one_le_transitionPath_up`: `have h := one_le_slotInteriorChips_add_head hEff (edge := transitionSlot i) (by rw [slotVertex_zero, transitionSlot_tail hcore]; exact hb) (by rw [slotVertex_length, transitionSlot_head hcore]; exact hnb)`, then `rwa [transitionSlot_head hcore] at h`.
- `one_le_transitionPath_down`: the same with the tail lemma, rewriting by `transitionSlot_tail hcore`.
- `burned_vMinus_of_chipFree`: `by_contra hnb`, `have := one_le_transitionPath_up hcore hEff i hb hnb`, `unfold transitionPathChips at hzero`, `have := hEff (spec.coreVertex (vPlus i))`, then `omega`. This drops the hic/hhead facts and the `mem_burned_slotVertex_of_chipFree_up` call with its manual `intro k hk0 hkle` branch.

The two cycle-blocking proofs in SpecBurning.lean could reuse the same lemmas for their hc1/hc2 steps.
findings.benefit: The chip-location reasoning is proved once per direction instead of three or more times in this file and twice more in SpecBurning.lean. The three tricycle lemmas shrink to the hcore bookkeeping plus a one-line omega, so a reader sees that they differ only in which transition slot they instantiate. Any change to the slot API, such as the exists_chip_* statements, then needs one edit instead of several.
